UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile and general application settings within the Nexus AI Sentinel app. This entity stores core user data, excluding sensitive authentication credentials which are managed by an external system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for identification. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 ExternalAuthSystem)

displayName.description: The user's preferred name for display within the application.

whatsapp.description: O número de WhatsApp do usuário para alertas críticos.

address.description: O endereço residencial ou comercial do usuário.

preferredDisplayMode.description: The user's preferred mode for financial explanations ('Essential' for simplified, 'Full' for technical data).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

UserConsent.title: UserConsent
UserConsent.description: Records a user's agreement to specific terms, policies, or disclaimers within the Nexus AI Sentinel app, particularly related to financial responsibility.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserConsent entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile entity that granted consent. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserConsent)

consentVersion.description: The version of the terms or policy to which the user consented. This helps track changes in agreements.

agreedAt.description: Timestamp when the user agreed to the terms.

ipAddress.description: The IP address from which the consent was given, for auditing purposes.

userAgent.description: The user-agent string of the device/browser used when consent was given, for auditing purposes.

definition.description: Stores core profile information and settings for a user. The document ID (`userId`) is the user's Firebase Authentication UID. The 'id' field within the document must match this UID for explicit ownership and authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user (Firebase Authentication UID).

definition.description: Records a user's agreement to specific terms, policies, or disclaimers. The 'userId' field in the document must match the path parameter `{userId}` for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user (Firebase Authentication UID).

params.name: consentId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific user consent record.

definition.description: Stores a user's manually registered financial assets and their storage locations. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence via path, ensuring the asset belongs to the user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user (Firebase Authentication UID).

params.name: assetId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific user asset.

definition.description: Stores AI-generated alerts and predictive insights tailored for a specific user. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence via path, linking the alert directly to the user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user (Firebase Authentication UID).

params.name: alertId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific AI-generated alert.

definition.description: Represents a unique chat session between a user and the AI assistant. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence via path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user (Firebase Authentication UID).

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific AI chat session.

definition.description: Individual messages within a user's AI chat session. Inherits authorization from its parent chat session and includes 'userId' for path-based security and 'sessionId' for referential integrity.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user (Firebase Authentication UID).

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent AI chat session.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific message within the chat session.

definition.description: Designated collection for identifying global administrators. The presence of a document at this path signifies administrative status for the corresponding UID, enabling simple DBAC checks without custom claims.

params.name: adminUid
params.description: The unique identifier of an administrator (Firebase Authentication UID).
